value.sql:
SELECT provinsi.nama AS wilayah, periode, nilai_indikator.nilai
FROM provinsi
JOIN nilai_indikator ON provinsi.kode = nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi
WHERE nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
  AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
  AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
ORDER BY nilai ASC; -- RANK

SELECT T1.nama AS wilayah, T2.period AS periode, SUM(T2.nilai) AS nilai
FROM provinsi AS T1
JOIN nilai_indikator AS T2 ON T1.kode = T2.kode_provinsi
WHERE T2.kode_indikator = :indikator AND T2.periode = :periode AND T1.kode IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY T1.nama, T2.period
ORDER BY nilai DESC;

SELECT provinsi.nama AS wilayah, periode, SUM(nilai) AS nilai
FROM nilai_indikator
INNER JOIN provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
  AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
  AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY provinsi.nama, periode
ORDER BY nilai DESC;

SELECT T1.nama AS wilayah, T2.periode, T2.nilai
FROM provinsi AS T1
JOIN nilai_indikator AS T2 ON T1.kode = T2.kode_provinsi
WHERE T2.kode_indikator = :indikator
  AND T2.periode = :periode
  AND T1.kode IN (:wilayah_0)
ORDER BY T2.nilai DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT provinsi.nama AS wilayah, nilai_indikator.periode AS periode, SUM(nilai_indikator.nilai) AS nilai
FROM nilai_indikator
JOIN provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator

AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY provinsi.nama, nilai_indikator.periode
ORDER BY nilai DESC

  provinsi.nama AS wilayah,

  nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
